INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_ACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,

				ACC_NO_UNMASKED,

				JSRC_FLG,

)
			SELECT 				
                CC.BR_CD,
                CC.SUB_BR_CD,
                CC.BASE_NO,
                CC.LAST6_BASE_NO,
                CC.CUST_NO,

                CC.STATUS,
                CC.MAKER_ID,
                CC.MAKER_DATE,
                CC.AUTH_ID,
                CC.AUTH_DATE,
                CC.REMARKS,
                CC.BALANCE,
                CC.INTER_COMP_ACCT,
                CC.ACCT_CREATION_TYPE,
                CC.LEGAL_ENTITY,
                CC.LEGACY_ACC_NO,
                CC.SOURCE_TYPE,
                CC.SOURCE_DESC,
                CC.VERSION,
                CC.HELD_WITH_BANK,
                CC.HOLDING_STATEMENT,
                CC.ACCT_SUB_TYPE,
                CC.ACCT_OPEN_DT,
                CC.RM_ID,
                CC.TAXABLE,
                CC.DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION,
                CC.DISPOSITION_ACCT,
                CC.BANK_NAME,
                CC.PREFERRED_FLAG,
                CC.BASE_NO_UNMASKED,
                CC.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED,
				CC.ACC_NO_UNMASKED,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_ACCOUNT] B
            ON CC.PORTFOLIO_NO  = B.PORTFOLIO_NO 
            AND CC.BASE_NO  = B.BASE_NO 
            AND CC.ACC_NO  = B.ACC_NO 
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_ACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.PORTFOLIO_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PORTFOLIO_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BASE_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BASE_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ACC_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACC_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
